notes.page_content: The sheet writes the target barred V intersection E_beta = empty-set and develops an argument using the Sigma family. It labels a Lemme, gives its displayed disjointness condition and a corrected conclusion, then labels a Corollaire describing the partition by the Sigma_alpha^+ pieces and V. The concluding sentence attributes immediacy to recurrence on card K >= 0. These are the manuscript's assertions; no mathematical check was performed.
